description: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with local official-source retrieval, conversion, and update checks. Source files are stored in each plugin installation's data folder.

interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools, with Swedish member-state and Turkish applicant-country pilot modules. Includes bundled deterministic retrieval, conversion, verification, and update discovery for registered official EU and national legal source packs. Each compatible desktop installation stores its own source files and update state in a persistent plugin data folder, without relying on the developer's project path.

name: freemovement-law
